bindings.label: 16-year-old male presented with four days of fever and one generalised seizure at home
Patient had chromosome 18q deletion and well-controlled epilepsy; no respiratory symptoms, and his mother was ill with a cough
Medical history included a normal echocardiogram from 2016 for evaluation of possible atrial septal defect, showing no abnormal cardiac anatomy and normal cardiac function

Physical examination revealed hemodynamic shock requiring intubation, intravenous crystalloid fluids >40 mL/kg, intravenous epinephrine infusion 0.4 μg/kg per min, and intravenous stress-dose hydrocortisone 100 mg
Chest X-ray shows bilateral hazy opacities
Severe sepsis secondary to bilateral pneumonia
Severe sepsis secondary to CNS infection (meningitis/encephalitis)
